info.title: Mobile Libraries API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API to retrieve UK mobile library services, timetables, routes, stops, road trips, live locations, and data schema conforming to the national schema.librarydata.uk specification.

tags.name: localauthorities
tags.description: UK local library authorities operating mobile library services

tags.name: mobiles
tags.description: Mobile library vehicles and real-time/estimated locations

tags.name: routes
tags.description: Regular recurring service routes and schedules for mobile libraries

tags.name: stops
tags.description: Individual stop locations, visiting dates/times, PDF flyers, ICS calendars, and vector tiles

tags.name: trips
tags.description: Driving trips between consecutive stops, geometry, and vector tiles

tags.name: schema
tags.description: Import and export data conforming to the official schema.librarydata.uk mobile library stops v2.0.0 specification

get.description: Returns a list of all local library authorities currently operating mobile library services in the database.

get.summary: Get local authority by ID or GSS code
get.description: Returns details of a specific local authority identified by either its internal numeric database ID or its 9-character GSS code (e.g. S12000041, E06000004).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric database ID or 9-character GSS code

get.description: Returns all mobile library vehicles, optionally filtered by local authority ID.

parameters.name: local_authority_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the local authority to filter by

200.description: A list of mobile library vehicles

get.summary: Get mobile library vehicle by ID
get.description: Returns details of a specific mobile library vehicle.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the mobile library vehicle

get.description: Returns current, previous, and upcoming stops with interpolated route sections for vehicles active on service today.
Finds nearest mobile libraries with stops within a given distance from specified WGS84 coordinates.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Search distance in metres (British National Grid projection)

get.description: Returns mobile library service routes, optionally filtered by local authority ID and/or mobile vehicle ID.

parameters.name: local_authority_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the local authority to filter by

parameters.name: mobile_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the mobile vehicle to filter by

get.description: Returns details of a specific route by ID.
Returns mobile library stops with extensive filtering, radial proximity search, pagination, and sorting. Supports both JSON and GeoJSON FeatureCollection output via the Accept header.

parameters.name: local_authority_ids
parameters.description: Pipe-separated list of local authority IDs (e.g. `44|56`)

parameters.name: mobile_ids
parameters.description: Pipe-separated list of mobile vehicle IDs

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees for radial search (used with latitude and distance)

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees for radial search (used with longitude and distance)

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radial distance in metres from the specified coordinates

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of stops to return

200.description: List of stops or GeoJSON FeatureCollection

X-Total-Count.description: Total matching count across all pages

get.description: Returns the nearest mobile library stops to given coordinates ordered by distance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of nearest stops to return

get.description: Returns details of a specific mobile library stop by ID.
Generates and downloads a printable timetable flyer for the stop in PDF format, including stop details, upcoming visit dates, and QR code.
Generates and downloads an iCalendar (.ics) calendar file containing the schedule of upcoming mobile library visits for this stop.

get.summary: Get Mapbox Vector Tile for stops
get.description: Returns a Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) containing stop point geometries and metadata for map tiles at zoom level z and tile coordinates x, y.
Returns driving route segments between consecutive mobile library stops including road geometry, distance, and duration.

200.description: List of trips or GeoJSON LineString FeatureCollection

get.description: Returns details of a specific driving trip by ID.

get.summary: Get Mapbox Vector Tile for trips
get.description: Returns a Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) containing driving trip linestrings for map tiles at zoom level z and tile coordinates x, y.

get.summary: Export all stops in national schema format
get.description: Exports all mobile library stop schedules conforming to schema.librarydata.uk/mobile-library-stops.json (v2.0.0). Supports CSV and JSON formats.

200.description: Full dataset conforming to v2.0.0 schema

schema.example:
local_authority,local_authority_code,mobile_name,route,community,stop,address,postcode,geox,geoy,day,type,arrival,departure,frequency,start,end,exceptions,timetable
Angus,S12000041,Van 1 - Isla,Van 1 - Isla - Week 1 - Monday,Wellbank,Gagiebank,"Gagiebank, Wellbank, Angus",DD5 3PT,-2.86258,56.52041,Monday,Public,10:30:00,11:00:00,FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2,2026-10-04,2027-03-31,,https://angusalive.scot/...

post.description: Uploads and imports mobile library stop schedules conforming to schema.librarydata.uk/mobile-library-stops.json (v2.0.0) into staging, automatically updating mobiles, routes, stops, and schedules.

requestBody.description: Array of stop records conforming to the v2.0.0 schema or equivalent CSV text

get.summary: Export stops for a local authority in national schema format
get.description: Exports mobile library stop schedules for a specific local authority (by authority name or 9-character GSS code) conforming to schema.librarydata.uk/mobile-library-stops.json (v2.0.0).

parameters.name: local_authority
parameters.description: Name or 9-character GSS code of the local authority

200.description: Authority stops conforming to v2.0.0 schema

LocalAuthority.description: A UK local library authority running mobile library services

country.description: Country name (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland)

timetable.description: URL to the service timetable page or document

website.description: Official website URL for the local authority or library service

colour.description: Hex colour code for branding and map visualization

logo.description: URL to the authority logo image

number_mobiles.description: Number of mobile library vehicles operated

Mobile.description: A mobile library vehicle operated by a local authority

local_authority_id.description: ID of the operating local authority

local_authority_code.description: GSS code of the operating local authority

name.description: Name or identifier of the mobile library vehicle

timetable.description: URL to the vehicle timetable document

number_routes.description: Number of routes served by this vehicle

number_stops.description: Number of stops served by this vehicle

MobileLocation.description: Estimated live location and stop progress of a mobile library vehicle

mobile_id.description: ID of the mobile library vehicle

current_stop_id.description: ID of the stop the vehicle is currently at (if stopped)

current_stop_departure.description: Scheduled departure time from current stop

next_stop_arrival.description: Expected arrival time at next stop

route_section.description: GeoJSON geometry of the estimated current route section

update_type.description: Type of location update (e.g. estimated or telemetry)

stop_distance.description: Distance to the nearest stop in metres

Route.description: A recurring service route operated by a mobile library vehicle

local_authority_code.description: GSS code of the local authority

mobile_id.description: ID of the assigned mobile library vehicle

timetable.description: URL to the timetable for this route

number_stops.description: Number of stops along this route

Stop.description: A physical mobile library stop location and schedule

route_ids.description: IDs of routes that serve this stop

route_names.description: Names of routes that serve this stop

mobile_ids.description: IDs of mobile vehicles that visit this stop

mobile_names.description: Names of mobile vehicles that visit this stop

local_authority_colour.description: Branding hex colour for the authority

address.description: Full street address of the stop

route_start.description: Start date of current route season

route_end.description: End date of current route season

route_days.description: Days of the week the stop is visited

type.description: Stop access type (Public, Private, Dynamic, Other)

exceptions.description: Dates when the stop will not be visited (e.g. bank holidays)

route_frequencies.description: RRULE recurrence frequency rules for the visiting routes

route_schedule.description: Calculated timestamps of all scheduled visits for this stop

timetable.description: Web URL to the published timetable

distance.description: Calculated distance in metres if radial coordinates were provided
Calculated distance from query point in metres

Trip.description: A road journey connecting two consecutive stops

route_line.description: GeoJSON LineString geometry of the road route

local_authority.description: Name of the local library authority

frequency.description: Recurrence pattern specified as an iCalendar RRULE

start.description: Date from which this schedule begins (YYYY-MM-DD)

properties.description: Stop metadata attributes with array values flattened to comma-separated strings

GeoJsonLineFeatureCollection.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing LineString trip features
